title: Export evaluation-ready decision-plane telemetry without raw context
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. He loads Agentic Recipe `decision_plane` with projection, fixture answers, model_ref, and a raw body that must not appear in telemetry. He performs `run_recipe` and verifies evaluation-ready fields without raw context. [^rc-dp-telemetry] [^insp-pa-08-telem]
implementation: Agentic Recipe `decision_plane` via `build_decision_plane_telemetry` / `DecisionPlaneRecipeAdapter`. Product CLI verb `run_recipe`.
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `telemetry_fields.yaml` drives `run_recipe`; hard expects on telemetry observation keys.
